description: Erection of single storey rear infill to both left and right of off-centre outrigger and installation of decking
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered block plan, unnumbered location plan, 20SHG_ELEV_04, 20SHG_SECT_05, 20SHG_GF PLAN_01, 20SHG_1F PLAN_02, 20SHG_2F&ROOF PLAN_03, design and access statement- received 09/04/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The boundary fence along the decking hereby approved shall be no less than 1.6metres above the decking level, towards the no 18. This shall be retained during the lifetime of the development.
